I will put fertilizer on this maize plot because on my own land I do not like leaving maize to struggle, and I have seen hybrid seed only pays well when I also feed it. I will still keep the spending careful, so I will use manure from home and one fertilizer program on this plot, but I will not buy pesticide or irrigation because that cash is hard to recover here. My family will do most of the work, and I will only hire a few people when planting and weeding are pressing.
